raw_segments.text: City-full passing away, other city-full coming, passing away too, other coming on, passing
Houses, lines of houses, streets, miles of pavements, piled up bricks, stones, changing
Other steps into his shoes when he gets his notice to quit.
They buy the place up with gold and still they have all the gold, swindle in it somewhere,
piled up in cities, worn away age after age.
Pyramids in sand, built on bread and onions, slaves' chinese wall.
Babylon, big stones left, round towers, rest rubble sprawling suburbs jerebilt, Kerwin's
mushroom houses built of breeze, shelter for the night.
